summary: Lands conditions C1+C2 of the A7 prelaunch G8 refusal (research/control/prospective_shadow_v1/audits/a7_prelaunch_g8.json, verdict REFUSED_FORWARD_EXECUTOR_ABSENT_IN_AUDITED_TIP). C1: new PRODUCTION forward executor research/shadow_v1/executor.py (ForwardExecutor) composing start-guard -> deterministic event_id -> ledger idempotency -> PIT fetch via data_feed (DATA_BLOCKED on gaps) -> adapter.decide -> risk.check_and_apply BEFORE any fill -> SleeveAccount virtual fills at the frozen fill rule -> settled funding once while held -> ONE plan-8 event with TARGET_INTENT-only action types and the no_order_proof digest. Explicit REDUCING_SELL_NETS_POSITION policy: the A7-confirmed gross overcount for reducing sells is fixed minimally in accounting.apply_fill (a sell that reduces/closes an existing long nets against the position, position-size check only, proceeds credit cash after fees/slippage; opening/increasing sells incl. flip-through-zero keep the UNCHANGED cash and gross checks). F6 feature-cutoff convention pinned as a required config value (feature_cutoff_offset_seconds; bars/buckets fetched with cutoff = decision - offset so only bars closing strictly before the decision enter the snapshot). No execution buffer, no sell slicing, no dust in production. C2: new research/shadow_v1/start_guard.py code-enforcing the forward-only rule (StartGuardError on any decision before SHADOW_START_UTC in the PROSPECTIVE namespace; missing SHADOW_START_UTC refuses everything in PROSPECTIVE; explicit REPLAY_NOT_PROSPECTIVE opt-in) with physically separated ledger roots (runtime_root/ledgers vs runtime_root/replay_not_prospective) and prospective_ledger_root() for callers/dashboard. INTERNAL PAPER ONLY throughout: no keys, no network in the executor, TARGET_INTENT + virtual fills only.

scheduler.py edit is one optional kwarg on pending_decisions; run_once/heartbeat semantics unchanged (test_shv1_scheduler.py passes unmodified).

The executor is tested end-to-end with a scripted FamilyAdapter over an in-memory feed (the constraint was NO test-local EXECUTOR); the three frozen family decide() paths are covered by the existing families/smoke suites. Driving a frozen adapter through ForwardExecutor is straightforward for the phase-E runner but not duplicated here.

Pending-fill-bar semantics: a due decision whose first post-decision bar has not completed yet (now < decision + interval) is left pending WITHOUT consuming its event_id; a genuine completed-bar gap raises DataBlocked and consumes the event_id as DATA_BLOCKED (audit ADJ1 semantics). The phase-E runner should invoke run_due only once the last decision's fill bar has completed.

A decision executed after a ledger loss would differ from the original only in observed_at_utc (idempotency is by deterministic event_id on the existing ledger); ledger bytes are otherwise reproducible from the frozen inputs.
Condition C1 explicitly requires a fresh-context A7 delta-audit of the executor at this new tip BEFORE SHADOW_START_UTC is written; this lane does not claim that audit.
Phase-E runner work remains: multi-family composition, process-restart sleeve rebuild, and heartbeat wiring are not part of this lane's deliverable.
Runtime ledgers default under runtime_root/ledgers (gitignored runtime area); no runtime ledger bytes are committed by this lane.
